pool.name: Pool generator
pool.notice: A drawing and take-off aid. It is not a structural, hydraulic, electrical or safety design: nothing here is checked for strength, ground water, uplift, cracking or entrapment. A licensed engineer must design and check the pool, and the local authority's rules apply. We accept no liability for what is built from it.
pool.governed.help: Leave a box empty and the generator fills it: from the spec you picked when it has a value, otherwise from a starting figure. Starting figures are not from any standard. Type your own figure to overrule either.
pool.series.note: Filter, motor and pipe sizes are generic size steps, not any maker's catalogue. The pump head is your own figure unless you ask for it to be calculated from the routed pipes. Choose the real equipment from your supplier's data.
pool.f.name: Name
pool.f.balancePct: Balance tank, share of the pool volume
pool.f.skimmerArea: Water surface per skimmer, at most
pool.f.surfaceShare: Share of the flow taken at the surface
pool.c.loopNote: Friction in the routed pipes by Hazen-Williams, bends, and your equipment figure. The roughness, bend factor and equipment loss are starting figures, not from a standard: replace them with the maker's and pipe supplier's. Not counted: pump height above the water, a dirty filter, valve throttling.
pool.f.roomGap: Machine room distance from the pool
pool.f.filterRateActual: Filter rate in the chosen filter
pool.f.velocity.surface: Velocity in the skimmer suction pipe
pool.f.velocity.drain: Velocity in the drain suction pipe
pool.opt.steps.side: In a corner of the shallow end
pool.from.start: starting figure, not from a standard
pool.read.secondary: read in a document that quotes the standard, not the standard itself
pool.spec.label: Spec in force
pool.spec.pick: Pick the spec the pool is designed to. Its values fill the empty boxes and the design is checked against it.
pool.spec.add: No spec add-on is switched on. Add “Pool spec: Europe” or “Pool spec: United States” from the Library (Settings, Add-ons) to bring norm values in. Until then every figure is yours or a starting figure.
pool.spec.counts: This spec holds {primary} values read in the standards themselves, {secondary} read in documents that quote them, and {none} rules with no value we could read. Check every value against your own copy of the standard and its national annex.
pool.spec.nonecheck: No spec in force: nothing was checked against a norm.
pool.check.none: Nothing in this design breaks a value the spec holds. That is not a design check.
pool.err.range: Out of range ({lo} to {hi}); the default is used.
pool.err.choice: Not one of the choices; the default is used.
pool.err.deeper: The deep end cannot be shallower than the shallow end; it was set equal.
pool.issue.below: {what}: {value} {unit} is below the spec's minimum of {limit} {unit}
pool.issue.above: {what}: {value} {unit} is above the spec's maximum of {limit} {unit}
pool.issue.nobarrier: An outdoor pool with no barrier drawn; the spec asks for one at least {limit} mm high
pool.issue.note: {what}: the spec's limit is {limit} {unit}; the bar layout uses {wall} mm in the walls and {floor} mm in the floor
pool.problem.steps.nofit: The steps would run {run} mm, more than the pool can take; none were made.
pool.problem.steps.last: The bottom riser is {last} mm against {riser} mm for the others.
pool.problem.filter.nofit: No filter in the size steps is big enough ({area} m² needed even with four).
pool.problem.pump.nofit: No motor in the size steps is big enough ({kw} kW needed).
pool.problem.pipe.nofit: No pipe in the size steps is big enough for the {line} line ({need} mm bore needed).
pool.problem.wall.thin: A {wall} mm wall leaves little room for two layers of steel at {cover} mm cover.
pool.problem.coping.narrow: The coping ({coping} mm) is narrower than the wall and tiles under it ({wall} mm).
pool.report.title: Pool quantities and figures
pool.act.ifc.done: Saved the pool as an IFC4 file.
pool.bim.note: Place in the model writes the pool into the open model on its first level, as elements you can select, schedule and save in the IFC file. One step that Undo takes back; placing again replaces the pool of the same name.
pool.bim.nolevel: The model has no level to stand the pool on. Open or start a model first.
pool.bim.place.label: place the pool
pool.bim.remove.label: remove the pool
pool.bim.none: No pool of this name is in the model.
pool.cad.note: Draw plan and section puts the pool into the drawing as lines, polylines, text and dimensions on POOL- layers. One step that Undo takes back. The lines do not follow later changes: remove and draw again. The IFC file is the 3D model.
pool.cad.draw.label: draw the pool
pool.cad.remove.label: remove the pool drawing
pool.cad.none: Nothing on a POOL- layer to remove.
pool.f.stepsAt: Middle of the steps along the side (0 = middle)
pool.f.benches: Benches: side, from, length (one per line)
pool.f.lapDia: Lap and floor leg, in bar diameters
pool.sides.help: Sides are numbered on the plan, counter-clockwise from the shallow end's corner nearest y = 0. Steps and benches are placed by side.
pool.act.md.done: Calculation page saved. In SuperCad Studio it also goes into the report binder under Calculations.
pool.net.line: Pipes as one connected network: {segments} straight lengths, {fittings} bends and junctions, {links} connections, with ports on every pipe, fitting, terminal, pump and filter in the IFC file. The machine room pipes are laid out square by fixed offsets and not checked for clashes; valves are not drawn.
pool.bar.note: One layer each way at the steel ratio, spaced no wider than the largest spacing. The lap, the floor leg and the 12 m stock length are starting figures, not from a standard. No corner bars, second layer or bars round openings: this is a schedule to estimate from, not a reinforcement design.
pool.problem.shape.notch: The L-shape's cut-out was larger than the pool; it was made smaller.
pool.problem.shape.corners: A freeform pool needs 3 to 200 corners; the rectangle is drawn instead.
pool.problem.shape.crossing: The freeform outline crosses itself; the rectangle is drawn instead.
pool.problem.shape.small: The freeform outline is smaller than 1 m by 1 m; the rectangle is drawn instead.
pool.problem.shape.offset: The outline is too narrow somewhere for its own walls; its bounding rectangle is drawn instead.
pool.problem.shape.text: A corner was not understood and was left out: {text}
pool.problem.shape.sharp: {n} corners are sharper than about 20 degrees: their walls and coping reach far out.
pool.problem.steps.outside: The steps on side {side} reach outside the water.
pool.problem.steps.side: There is no side {side} (the pool has {sides}); no steps were made.
pool.problem.bench.bad: A bench was not understood and was left out: {text}
pool.problem.bench.fit: The bench on side {side} does not fit (outside the water or its seat below the floor); it was left out.
pool.problem.gate.nofit: The gate ({width} mm) does not fit in the barrier; no gate was made.
pool.problem.rebar.many: {n} bars are too many to draw; the schedule is still there.
